name: CareBridge Clinical Emergency Red Flags
disclaimer: Rule-based emergency triggers that bypass ML risk scores and elevate referral urgency to 'emergency'. All rules are decision support and marked 'needs clinician review'. Standard emergency protocols supersede any decision support score.

rules.name: Severe Hypoxemia
rules.source: WHO Clinical Management of Severe Acute Respiratory Infection / BTS Guidelines

rules.name: Chest Pain with Hemodynamic or Respiratory Instability
rules.criterion: chest_pain == true AND (sbp < 90 OR sbp > 180 OR heartrate > 120 OR o2sat < 92)
rules.source: AHA/ACC Suspected Acute Coronary Syndrome Emergency Triage Protocol

rules.name: Acute Neurological Deficit (FAST / Stroke Signs)
rules.criterion: stroke_signs == true OR facial_droop == true OR acute_weakness == true
rules.source: AHA/ASA Early Management of Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke

rules.name: Hypertensive Crisis
rules.source: 2017 ACC/AHA High Blood Pressure Clinical Practice Guideline

rules.name: Shock / Profound Hypotension
rules.source: Surviving Sepsis Campaign / Critical Care Shock Guidelines

rules.name: Altered Mental Status / Lethargy / Unresponsiveness
rules.source: Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS) / GCS Emergency Thresholds
